title: Quaint Springy Norwegian Tempeh Skewers
description: A cultured and comforting Norwegian dish featuring tempeh, this recipe is perfect for a spring evening, combining the freshness of Mediterranean flavors with the heartiness of Norwegian cuisine. It is a unique blend of international flavors on a skewer.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, ensuring the grates are clean and brushed with oil to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, dill, salt, and pepper to make the marinade.
Add the tempeh pieces to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated tempeh, cherry tomatoes, onions, and bell peppers onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tempeh is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
Consider serving with a side of quinoa or roasted potatoes for a filling meal.
